source_rules.note: Community/discussion sources are allowed but must keep their provenance label; they may not be promoted to sourced_evidence.

evidence_rules.note: A budgeting mechanism is educational organization; it may be described, never proven to save money.

scope_boundaries: Household money organisation and decision support only.
Not regulated financial advice, debt counselling, credit advice, investment advice, therapy, relationship counselling, or emergency financial assistance.
Never guarantees savings, affordability, debt outcomes, income growth, or investment returns.
required_disclosures: Educational content — not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice.
Money guidance is general education, not regulated personal financial advice; it never guarantees savings, affordability, debt outcomes, income growth, or investment returns.

escalation.behavior: When the situation moves beyond ordinary planning (behind on essential bills, unrepayable borrowing pressure, or health/safety impact), the product must state its scope boundary and direct the customer to a qualified, regulated professional in their own country; it must not invent specific services or numbers.

savings_claim_rules.reason: The canonical product states Buy/Wait/Never + audit efficacy is untested (hypothesis). Savings must never be presented as proven.

dated_baseline_rules.rule: Any market-sensitive cost/price example must carry a checked-on/review date and be distinguishable from the durable mechanism; examples are labelled illustrative.

currency_context_rules.rule: Amounts are shown in the customer's own currency; no universal money figure is asserted; no FX conversion of numerics.

freshness_rules.rule: Price/affordability examples expire; require a date within the product's own declared review cadence.

applicability_rules.rule: Provide one canonical product; context (income shape, market, tier) is applied at the customer level, never by cloning per country.

contradiction_rules.rule: A savings/efficacy statement contradicts the canonical untested-efficacy limitation and must be rejected.

uncertainty_rules.rule: Mechanism efficacy is hypothesis-stage; label it as such.

automatic_authorization_conditions: dated baseline present for market-sensitive examples
automatic_rejection_conditions: a prohibited claim class is present
a savings or efficacy claim is asserted
risk class exceeds the pack's coverage

provenance.note: Encodes the ACTUAL permitted scope of PPL-FAMILY-MONEY-001 from its canonical safety record. It does NOT treat the product as regulated financial advice.
